name: Marta — 160 thermic hours, mountain cross-country, has run out of wing
summary: Flies weekly in the Alps, well over 100 hours of thermic time, 30km-plus declared flights, half a dozen sites, phase-aware hands, two manoeuvres courses, and she can name the flights where her high-B cost her the goal. Instructor has said she's ready.
why_this_persona: The unambiguous Ready case, and the control for every conservative mechanism in this rubric: the thermic-hours gate, the collapse-response gate, the aspirational gate and the asymmetric-risk threshold all have to leave her alone. She is also the control for the two new questions — she scores well on site variety and cross-country because she has genuinely done both, not because they were waived.

notes: Computed skills 98.1, psychological 100.0, total 99.0 plus a 2-point manoeuvres bonus, clamped to 100. Comfortably past the Ready threshold of 78 before the bonus is added, which is the guard against the bonus ever being load-bearing — BRIEF.md requires SIV to be a small positive signal only.

'siv_before_you_upgrade' must NOT fire for her, and that is the only place in this persona set where that suggestion is silent: she has done more than one course, practises regularly and has flown out a real asymmetric, so every branch of its trigger is false. Worth checking, because the trigger is deliberately the broadest of any SIV suggestion in the ladder.

'resale_and_cost' must NOT fire. Its trigger is a Not yet or Nearly ready result, or a 'replacing anyway' motive — a pilot who is genuinely ready does not need talking out of it, and firing it here would read as hedging a clear result.

She answers 'strong thermic or big mountain days' and takes full marks for it, as at mid-B to high-B. This step's sources explicitly expect genuinely turbulent thermic air, so this is the one conditions answer the rubric does not mark down at all.

Note the 0.9 on 'proper thermic days, fairly regularly' in the scoring config — she avoids it by answering the top band. A persona answering 'regular_thermic_days' loses a point of skills at this step where they would not have one rung down; persona 02 is that case.
